name: hud_ui_options_panel_perspective_sync_from_options
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_Perspective::SyncFromOptions toggles the perspective checkbox, writes the current hardware-mode graphics flags with the perspective bit set or cleared to match the new checked state, and refreshes renderer span routines.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster. The current source restores behavior and table ownership; exact VC5SP3 byte comparison remains a later pass.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40ca40 reads zOpt::GetGraphicsFlagsForCurrentHwMode, calls HudUiCheckToggleWidget::OnActivate, sets or clears zOpt_GraphicsFlags_Perspective in the saved flags according to self->checked, calls zRndr::SelectSpanRoutines, and returns.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_perspective_sync_from_options_smoke patches zRndr::SelectSpanRoutines to an isolated counter, installs software and hardware graphics flag option pointers, exercises set and clear transitions through OnActivate, verifies only the current hardware-mode flag word is updated, and verifies span routine selection is called once per sync.
